instruction: Create a summary of my LibreOffice Impress presentation 'Dickinson_Slides.pptx' in a Word document called 'presentation_summary.docx' on the Desktop. For each slide, write the slide number and its title in the format 'Slide 1: Title'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a summary document with slide numbers and titles. Verified by reading the actual PowerPoint file: 9 slides with titles as listed in expected_summary. The evaluator parses the Word document to extract (slide_number, title) pairs and checks if they match the expected summary. Gives partial credit: score = matched_entries / total_expected_entries.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts slide summary from Word document by parsing paragraphs and matching pattern 'Slide N: Title'
Metric correctly handles expected parameter (direct access to rules dict when type='rule')
Partial credit properly implemented: counts matched entries and returns matched/total score
Case-insensitive and whitespace-normalized title comparison for robust matching
Expected values verified from actual PowerPoint file (9 slides with correct titles)
Complete coverage: evaluator checks all 9 slides and their titles as required by instruction
Edge cases handled: empty result list, missing expected_summary
Data flow is correct: getter extracts (slide_num, title) pairs → metric compares with expected → returns score
